audience: product teams that collect and answer feature requests in Canny

useCases.title: Rank the most-voted feature requests
useCases.text: List the posts of a board with their status and score. Then list the votes on one post.

useCases.title: Trace the status history of a post
useCases.text: Retrieve one post with its status and roadmaps. Then list its status changes, newest first.

useCases.title: Review the companies behind a request
useCases.text: List companies with their name, domain, MRR and custom fields. Search by name or segment.

useCases.title: Post a feature request for a user
useCases.text: Create a feedback post on a board, as a user. Other users of the portal can see it.

useCases.title: Move a post to planned
useCases.text: Change the status of a post, for example to planned. The notify flag decides whether voters get an email.

useCases.title: Comment on a post or add an internal note
useCases.text: Add a comment to a post as a user. Set the internal flag for an admin-only note. Then list the comments on the post.
